question: An electric oven is rated 2500 W. The energy used by it in 5 hours will be:
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.5 kWh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The unit of energy is measured in **kWh (kilowatt-hour),** which is the amount of energy consumed by a **1000 W device** in one hour.
 
• The electric oven is rated at** 2500 W,** which means it consumes **2.5 kWh of energy in one hour.**
 
• To calculate the energy used by the oven in** 5 hours**, we need to multiply the power rating by the time duration: **2500 W x 5 hours = 12,500 Wh**.
 
• Since** 1 kWh = 1000 Wh**, we need to convert the energy from watt-hours to kilowatt-hours: **12,500 Wh x 1000 = 12.5 kWh**.
 
• Therefore, the energy used by the electric oven in 5 hours is** 12.5 kWh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kilowatt hours (kWh) **are the unit of measurement for **energy consumption, **which is the **entire amount of energy** used for a specific process.
 
• This covers the usage of fuels such as **oil, gas, diesel, electricity, and biomass.**
 
• **E = P × (t/1000) **is the formula for energy consumption, where P is the** power unit** in watts, t is the** amount of time **that the power or energy was consumed, and E is the** energy measured** in** Joules or kilowatt-hours **(kWh).
